reviews.author: Lalitta Blosser
reviews.text: For our 35th Wedding Anniversary we did something different and stayed at the Treehouse. Just so nice. Everything we needed was there, and then some;  it was clean, and morning walks by the river were great. Visited with the cows and horses too. Logan did a great job on our yummy steak meal. Our table was even decorated for the two of us and we loved visiting with him. We loved it all. Even though I grew up on a large farm, and milked cows, this was special.

reviews.author: Michell Bell
reviews.text:
I just have to share this amazing experience!

We came to Wichita, Kansas, to visit our daughter while she’s interning at Textron Aviation. Since we’d never been to Kansas before, we were looking for something unique to do over a long weekend. After reading so many great reviews, we decided to visit Diamond Springs Ranch for a true Kansas prairie horseback riding experience, and it exceeded every expectation.

From the moment we arrived, we felt less like customers and more like guests in someone’s home. The hospitality was genuine, the service was warm and welcoming, and every part of the experience was thoughtfully done.

Logan, thank you for creating such a special place! Our family had an amazing time.

A huge thank you to Luke behind the bar for the great conversation and hospitality, Jessica for leading an incredible horseback trail ride through the beautiful prairie, and Louie (I hope I got your name right!) for serving some of the best smoked BBQ we’ve had. It was absolutely delicious!

As if the horseback riding wasn’t enough, we also got to feed the three adorable Highland cattle, which was such a fun and memorable experience. They also offer glamping on-site, and after seeing the property, it’s definitely on our list for a future visit.

If you’re looking for an authentic Kansas experience with incredible people, beautiful prairie scenery, amazing food, and unforgettable horseback riding, I can’t recommend Diamond Springs Ranch enough. This was easily one of the highlights of our trip, and we’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Jaicia Mills
reviews.text: If we could give more stars we would. We stayed in the Wagon just for an evening and did horse back riding to celebrate our anniversary. The property is gorgeous, and staff were all so super nice. A storm did come throughout the night, however the wagon was so comfortable that it wasn’t awful/uncomfortable. We definitely plan on going back in the future!

reviews.author: AJ Bowen
reviews.text:
We were in town for a wedding at the nearby Gooseberry Creek venue (3 minutes away by car) and booked a stay at the Diamond Springs covered wagon "Sunset Schooner". It was unbelievably convenient, especially given that the nearest hotels were otherwise 15+ minutes away.

The covered wagon was a fantastic and memorable place to stay. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The owners and staff were friendly and helpful, and they went above and beyond for us, showing us around the property and arranging a last-minute trail ride. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable stay in the area.

reviews.author: Jacob Svoboda
reviews.text:
If you’re on the fence about booking a stay at Diamond Springs Ranch—just do it. This place exceeded every expectation we had.

We stayed in the treehouse cabin, which was an experience in itself—peaceful, unique, and the perfect mix of rustic and comfortable. The lodge was just as impressive, with a welcoming, homey feel that makes it easy to settle in and relax.

The horseback riding was a highlight of the trip. We did several sunset rides that were absolutely unforgettable. Huge credit to Logan, who runs the horses—everything was smooth, safe, and clearly well cared for. Jordan, our trail guide, was fantastic—knowledgeable, fun, and made the ride feel personal rather than just another tour. Brian and Hali were also incredibly helpful and added to the overall experience.

One of the coolest parts? Getting to spend time with the Highland cows. It’s not something you get to do every day, and it really adds to the charm of the ranch.

But what truly sets this place apart is the people. Byron and Susan have built something special here, and it shows in every detail. Everyone we met was genuinely kind, welcoming, and passionate about what they do. By the end of the trip, it didn’t feel like we were just visiting—it felt like we were part of something.

We came for a getaway and left with great memories and even better connections. Already looking forward to going back.
